results.title: Happily Married
results.overview: Anis and Anamika are complete opposites, brought together by an unexpected marriage. Can the responsible Anis and the free-spirited, modern Anamika overcome their differences and build a happy life together?

results.title: Don't
results.overview: Two women, Morgan and Rea, relive their past relationship through a series of fragmented memories, revealing not just the past, but the distance between them now.

results.title: Because I Have To
results.overview: Miloš Šejn: lying down, awake. And above all, creating. This documentary essay follows an artist whose work is “born of wonder” and who effortlessly navigates his longed-for path out of the city. Instead of an endless stream of sensory input, the film offers a space for concentration and mindfulness—a space that may well extend beyond the seventy minutes spent in the cinema

results.title: Disconnected
results.overview: Centers around the Walker family as they navigate personal loss and the consequences of online manipulation. Set against the backdrop of a school system heavily reliant on technology, the Walker’s and a group of courageous students challenge a corrupt administration as they fight to reclaim their community and their lives.

results.title: Raw Plan
results.overview: When Christina returns as a teacher to the school where she was once a student herself, she carries with her a past she thought was long over. In the classroom she is confronted with the problematic Mathilde, 16, who has lived in a shelter since her mother's death. Their meeting sets off a power struggle that quickly grows beyond the classroom walls. Mathilde struggles to hold on to a world that is falling apart around her, while Christina struggles not to become who she once was. Harassment, secrets and lies pull them towards a darkness neither of them can control.

results.title: Interlude
results.overview: Following a failed suicide attempt, Clara is in a coma and discovers that the afterlife is a giant Scrabble tournament. It all makes no sense, and yet, she must win the competition to overcome her demons.

results.title: Föa - Once Upon A Future
results.original_title: Föa - C'era una volta il futuro
results.overview: Nicole, alone at home while pregnant during the G8 demonstrations in Genoa, unwisely opens the door to a group of protesters. During the forced cohabitation, the private world of the woman and the public world of the boys collide and end up changing each other.

results.title: Romare Bearden: A Life in Collage
results.original_title: Romare Bearden: A Life in Collage
results.overview: An athlete, artist, and activist, Romare Bearden defied boundaries placed on Black men of his generation. He partied with James Baldwin in Paris, composed hit songs, and channeled his memories into powerful collages celebrating Black life that changed contemporary art. He challenged social injustice and broke down barriers in art, culminating in a vibrant artistic legacy that inspires and empowers artists, dancers, and musicians.

results.title: When people ask where you're from
results.original_title: When people ask where you're from
results.overview: Sonja Aigner, born in South Africa and now living in Germany, reflects on identity and belonging after a DNA test reveals connections across the world.Through a quiet and intimate conversation, the film explores what it means to come from a place and whether that answer is ever complete.

results.title: Little Happy Pills
results.overview: A young woman tries to keep a steady balance between her expectations, desires and personal life, however, her emotions and everyday routine keep getting in her way.

results.title: Skyclimber: Scaling the Eiffel Tower
results.overview: Urban free climber Adam Lockwood attempts to scale the Eiffel Tower in a documentary that is equal parts high-altitude adventure and intimate personal portrait. A film that builds its tension with the precision of a heist movie, mapping every step of an audacious ascent.

results.title: Waves of Silence
results.overview: Between helping his mother run her hotel and looking after his birds, Amon who is deaf, feels an immediate connection with new water delivery man, Roberto, as best friend Daniella sets her eyes on him also.

results.title: Angel and the Badman
results.overview: A wounded outlaw finds unexpected mercy in the care of a rancher's daughter. The hope of love pulls him toward a different life until the law, and his violent past, close in on his new home. Now he must choose the kind of man he'll become.

results.title: When Silence Barks
results.overview: At 17, Jérémy dreams of becoming a filmmaker and shares an incredibly close bond with his older brother Théo, a rising rap artist. But the onset of psychotic symptoms throws the family’s fragile balance into turmoil. Amid denial, crises and attempts to create together, the two brothers fight to preserve their bond. Jérémy must learn to accept his illness, live with it, and ultimately let go of the life he had imagined for himself.

results.title: To Let in a Wolf
results.overview: Two men have sheltered in a remote bunker. When a stranger comes seeking refuge, their fragile coexistence unravels.

results.title: Grotesca
results.overview: Camila is a young woman tormented by cannibalistic thoughts. When one day her partner, Victoria, volunteers to satisfy that need, Camila is torn by an internal conflict that, in the days that follow, will make her oscillate between desire, love, and guilt, confronting the emotional roots of her compulsion in search of a decision.

results.title: Wild No More
results.overview: On the verge of divorce, Yawen works at a quiet suburban bowling alley. A group of women rent out the venue for a wild bachelorette party, ready to savor their freedom. After a flashy show, they prank Yawen by handcuffing her and a go-go boy together before taking off. Sharing the same space, the two seem connected, yet remain unable to truly connect.

results.title: Dreadful Mother
results.overview: Victoria awakens with a broken arm in a country house after being kidnapped. A doctor and nun care for her, but as she gradually uncovers their secrets, she realizes things aren't what they seem.
